change.title: 03/06 · Stock market investment: March 1972–December 1977
change.reason: Create the requested process with event.us_nyse_start as its start, event.office as an interior milestone, and 31 December 1977 as its end. The earlier lottery payout is an input. The USD 251,600,000 outcome is interpreted as ending investment-asset value, not cumulative revenue or net profit. No reverse event-to-process or outcome-to-event links are added.
